applies_to: ACH480 drives running the ACH480 HVAC control program, embedded fieldbus (EFB) Modbus RTU, addressing mode 0 (default); firmware manual 3AXD50000247134 Rev E.
summary: ABB's compact HVAC variable frequency drive with a built-in RS-485 port that speaks Modbus RTU (as well as BACnet MS/TP and N2). The first six holding registers carry the control word, two references, status word and two actual values; every parameter is also a holding register derived from its group and index. This map covers the cyclic block, the error registers, key 01/04/05 monitoring parameters, the comm-loss settings and the main 32-bit actual values.

addressing.note: The manual uses 6-digit references 400001-465536 for the 65536 holding registers, so 400001 = wire address 0. Masters limited to 5 digits can use 40001-49999 for 400001-409999; 32-bit parameter registers (420000+) need 6-digit or raw addressing. With 58.33 Addressing mode = Mode 0 (default) a 16-bit parameter gg.ii sits at 400000 + 100*gg + ii (e.g. 01.11 -> 400111, wire 110) and a 32-bit copy at 420000 + 200*gg + 2*ii (e.g. 01.07 -> 420214, wire 20213). Mode 1 uses 400000 + 256*gg + ii and Mode 2 uses 400000 + 512*gg + 2*ii; this map assumes Mode 0. 32-bit registers are listed CDAB, which assumes 58.34 Word order = LO-HI, the default.

firmware: ACH480 HVAC control program, manual revision E

source.title: ACH480 HVAC control program firmware manual
source.pages: EFB setup pp. 263-265; register addressing pp. 267-268; control/status words pp. 270-275; start/stop sequence p. 279; holding register table p. 282; error registers p. 289; parameters 01/04/05 pp. 373-379; group 58 pp. 575-581; Additional parameter data (FbEq32) pp. 653-655, 681

notes: Registers 400001-400006 are the factory defaults of Data I/O 1-6 (58.101-58.106) and can be re-pointed; 400007-400014 are user-selectable via 58.107-58.114 and are not listed.

Control and status word bits are shown for the ABB Drives profile (58.25 = 0, default). With the DCU profile (58.25 = 5) the words are passed through unconverted with a different bit layout (bit 0 STOP, bit 1 START, bit 2 REVERSE, bit 4 RESET...). In this HVAC program control-word bits 8 and 9 are reserved (no jogging).

Reference/actual registers are signed 16-bit; 20000 corresponds to the value of 46.01 Speed scaling or 46.02 Frequency scaling (46.03 torque), so their engineering value depends on drive settings and is left unscaled here.
32-bit registers follow 58.34 Word order; the default LO-HI sends the low word first (CDAB). With HI-LO the order becomes ABCD. Within each register the high byte is sent first.

16-bit scaling is the manual's FbEq16 column (e.g. '10 = 1 V' -> scale 0.1); 32-bit scaling is the FbEq32 column in the Additional parameter data chapter. Parameters whose 16-bit scaling is 'See par. 46.xx' (01.01, 01.06, 01.07, 01.10, 01.14, 01.72-01.74) are listed only in their 32-bit form.

Left out: 06.xx control/status words, 05.10 control board temperature (unit depends on a setting), 01.50-01.53 hour/day kWh logs, HVAC-specific groups (PID, multipump, override) and configuration parameters other than the comm-loss settings.

58.16 Communication loss time (default 30.0 s, range 0.0-6000.0 s) is left out: its 16-bit scaling is printed as '1 = 1 s' while the 32-bit table gives '10 = 1 s', so the 16-bit integer's unit is unclear.
Coils and discrete inputs also exist but are omitted.
If 96.78 Legacy Modbus mapping is enabled (ACx550-style register numbering), the register layout changes and this map no longer applies.

registers.name: Control word (EFB CW)
registers.description: ABB Drives profile bits shown; DCU profile layout differs (58.25).

bits.0: OFF1_CONTROL: 1 = ready to operate, 0 = ramp stop (OFF1)
bits.1: OFF2_CONTROL: 0 = emergency OFF, coast to stop
bits.4: RAMP_OUT_ZERO: 0 = force ramp output to zero
bits.6: RAMP_IN_ZERO: 0 = force ramp input to zero
bits.10: REMOTE_CMD: 1 = fieldbus control; 0 = last CW/reference kept unless both are 0

integration.summary: Set 58.01 = Modbus RTU, point the start/stop and reference sources at the embedded fieldbus, then write the ABB Drives control word and Reference 1 at 400001/400002 and poll the status word and actual values at 400004-400006. Read further monitoring values from their parameter registers (400000 + 100*group + index).
integration.enable: Set 58.01 Protocol enable = Modbus RTU, then 58.03 node address, 58.04 baud and 58.05 parity, and apply them with 58.06 Communication control = Refresh settings (or reboot). For control set 20.01 Ext1 commands (and 20.06 for EXT2) = Embedded fieldbus and the reference source, e.g. 22.11 Ext1 speed ref1 or 28.11 Ext1 frequency ref1 = EFB ref1. Save parameter writes permanently with 96.07 Parameter save manually.
integration.watchdog: 58.14 Communication loss action (No action by default / Fault / Last speed / Speed ref safe / Fault always / Warning) with 58.16 Communication loss time (default 30.0 s) and 58.15 Communication loss mode (default: only control word/reference writes reset the timer). A loss trips 6681 EFB comm loss or warns A7CE; 'Speed ref safe' runs at 22.41/28.41. There is a 30 s boot-up delay before monitoring starts.
quirks: Addresses are 6-digit Modicon references: 400001 = wire 0. 32-bit parameter registers start at 420000 and cannot be reached with 5-digit (4xxxx) addressing.
32-bit values in this map are listed CDAB, which assumes 58.34 Word order = LO-HI (default). If 58.34 is set to HI-LO, read them as ABCD.
References and actual values are signed 16-bit with 20000 = the 46.01/46.02 scaling value, not engineering units.
Only the lower 16 bits of the drive's 32-bit control/status words are visible at 400001/400004.

Start (manual's sequence): write 1142 (0x476); when status bit 0 is 1 write 1150 (0x47E, ready/stopped), then 1151 (0x47F) to run. Stop: 1143 (0x477) per 21.03 Stop mode, 1150 OFF1 ramp stop, 1149 (0x47D) OFF2 coast, 1147 (0x47B) OFF3 emergency ramp. Fault reset: rising edge of control-word bit 7.
setup: Defaults: node 1, 19.2 kbit/s, 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit (58.03-58.05); 58.04 can also be Autodetect.
Changes to group 58 take effect only after 58.06 = Refresh settings or a control-unit reboot.
58.07 Communication diagnostics flags parity, baud and addressing errors; 58.08-58.12 count packets and errors.
gotchas: The same RS-485 port also runs BACnet MS/TP or N2; 58.01 decides which protocol is active.
If 96.78 Legacy Modbus mapping is enabled the drive uses ACx550-style register numbering and this map no longer applies.
Exception 04h means the drive rejected the request; read 400092 Error code for the reason.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
